SELECT id, task_code, task_name, initiation_id, parent_id, task_level, wbs_path, sort_order, task_type, planned_start_date, planned_end_date, actual_start_date, actual_end_date, duration_days, planned_effort, actual_effort, progress_pct, owner_id, owner_name, assignee_ids, priority, status, depends_on, milestone, description, deliverable, risk_level, tenant_id, provider_trace_id, created_by, created_at, updated_by, updated_at, deleted FROM ydsz_execution_wbs_task WHERE parent_id = #{parentId} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY sort_order ASC
